delivery.label: On-time delivery
delivery.rule: Tasks due this week finished on or before their target end ÷ tasks due this week.

effort_accuracy.label: Effort accuracy
effort_accuracy.rule: Tasks closed this week: 100 − |1 − effort ratio| × 100, where effort ratio = actual ÷ estimated hours (×1.00 scores 100; ×1.25 or ×0.75 scores 75).

updates.label: Daily updates
updates.rule: End-of-day updates posted ÷ working days so far (proof link required when the company setting says so).

demo.label: Friday demo
demo.rule: Friday demo of working software shown this week (100) or not (0).

timesheet.label: Timesheet
timesheet.rule: Hours logged ÷ (working days × minimum hours a day); leave rows count.

early_warning.label: Early warning
early_warning.rule: Of the tasks that slipped (or are forecast to), the share whose slip was flagged before the due date.

approvals.label: Approval KPI
approvals.rule: The approval KPI (Approvals page): decisions on time ÷ (on time + lapses), where a lapse is a week decided after the deadline or still waiting past it; credited to whoever decided, including a delegate. The running week uses the last 30 days, like the Approvals page.

followups.label: Follow-ups
followups.rule: 100 minus 25 for each overdue next step.

ops.label: Duties on time
ops.rule: Recurring duties done by their due date ÷ duties due this week.
